title: Account Assistant - Temp
description:
Finance Reconciliation Officer

Temporary Contract Finance Department

Reporting to: Bursar
Department: Finance
Contract Type: Temporary

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Finance Reconciliation Officer to support the Finance Department in an Independent School on a temporary basis. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional with strong Sage Accounting and advanced Excel skills who can confidently reconcile supplier and customer accounts, investigate discrepancies, and provide accurate financial reporting.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring financial records are accurate, fully supported, and presented clearly to the Bursar.

Key Responsibilities
- Reconcile supplier and customer accounts, ensuring balances are accurate and up to date.
- Review and investigate historical discrepancies, missing transactions, and outstanding balances.
- Collect and organise supporting documentation, including invoices, statements, payments, and credit notes.
- Identify and resolve aged balances, duplicate transactions, and unapplied payments.
- Use Sage Accounting to review transactions, analyse account balances, and extract reports.
- Prepare detailed reconciliation schedules and reports using Excel.
- Maintain accurate and organised audit trails for all reconciliations.
- Present findings and recommendations clearly to the Bursar.
- Escalate significant issues with proposed solutions where appropriate.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Strong practical experience using Sage Accounting Software.
- Advanced Excel skills, including:
- Pivot Tables
- VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
- SUMIFS
- Data analysis and reporting
- Proven experience reconciling supplier and customer accounts.
- Strong understanding of:
- Purchase Ledger
- Sales Ledger
- Payments
- Credit Notes
- Account Balances
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain financial information clearly.

Key Deliverables
- Fully reconciled supplier and customer account balances.
- Complete supporting documentation for all reconciliations.
- Clear records of discrepancies identified and actions taken.
- Summary reconciliation reports for the Bursar.
- Accurate financial records supported by a robust audit trail.

Apply Now

If you have strong Sage and Excel skills, excellent reconciliation experience, and enjoy resolving complex accounting discrepancies, we would like to hear from you.

Contact Muzna Naqvi at Reed Reading Office for more details

title: Accounts Payable & Account Receivable Specialiist
description:
Morson are recruiting on behalf of an Aerospace company based in Reading that designs and develops the next-generation sixth-generation combat aircraft for the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP).

The Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable Specialist will join the team at a critical time in the GCAP programme, the standing up and fast growth of the Joint Venture. This is a rare opportunity to have a long-term impact on the success of the JV, by playing a crucial role in the initial stages of the life of the new organisation and laying the foundations for its success through carrying out the sound transactional financial services and inputting into the design of the function.

This position is critical for the company and will be a member of the team responsible for the operation of the Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) function ensuring the accuracy of the company's accounts and maintaining the company's assets and liabilities.

You will contribute to the smooth operation of accounting processes through daily management of incoming and outgoing invoices, proposing and running payment runs, performing reconciliation of the subledgers and supplier statements, and collaboration with relevant stakeholders through monthly Aged Creditor/Debtor reviews and GRNI reviews.
This role will report into the Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable Manager.

Key Accountabilities;
Accounts Payable Related Duties;
- Accurately and timely posting of payable invoices entries relating to Accounts Payable, accrued expenses, and prepaid expenses.
- Reconcile AP Subledger balances with invoices received from supplier.
- Verify appropriateness of payments through reconciling invoices, Good Receipts, and Purchase Orders (3-way matching) and managing and resolving GRNI exceptions through Aged GRNI Reviews.
- Prepare payment schedules aligned with due dates and create bank transfer data working together with Treasury team.
- Review and process Non PO and Ad-hoc payments
- Managed aged and blocked invoices through organising and chairing of Aged Creditor Reviews.

Accounts Receivable Related Duties;
- Confirm incoming money in bank accounts and perform Cash allocations (application/matching) against billing data
- Identify overdue receivables and collaborate with Sales team to promote collection
- Conduct AR balance confirmation procedures with customers, especially at period-end

Other General Duties;
- Support month-end and year-end closing processes, including verifying AP/AR account balances, conducting account analysis, and preparing audit documentation
- Propose and implement improvements to accounting processes through digitalisation, automation, and governance and internal control enhancements
- Supplier and customer query handling and management, ensuring a positive relationship with all stakeholders and supporting the Treasury team with cashflow forecasting

Qualifications;
- The jobholder will possess strong curiosity about figures
- Excellent accuracy and attention to detail and the ability to meet deadlines
- Strong communication skills with the ability to liaise confidently with internal and external stakeholders
- Flexible to changes and proactive in pursuing business process improvements
- Practical experience in either AP, AR, or both and
basic bookkeeping knowledge
- PC proficiency in Excel
- Experience using ERP system such as SAP would be an advantage
- Have an ability to collaborate with stakeholders and colleagues of various backgrounds, relaying financial concepts in a simple and understandable manner
- Language proficiency in Japanese or Italian would be an advantage.

This is an excellent opportunity to join the business at an exciting time.

Morson is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Accounts assistant; accounts payable, accounts receivable; purchase ledger; sales ledger; SAP; SAGE; AAT; payroll; VAT returns; reconciliation; credit control; Japanese; Italian

title: Accounts Payable (Sole Charge role)
description:
Accounts Payable Specialist (Sole charge role)

Location: Maidenhead outskirts (near all public transport routes)
Salary: Up to 38,000 per annum, depending on experience
Working Pattern: Hybrid working - After 2-3-months of full training in the office
Contract: Permanent, Full-Time

The Accounts Payable opportunity

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Accounts Payable Specialist to join a growing business based in Maidenhead.

This is an excellent opportunity for a confident and hands-on Accounts Payable professional to take full ownership of the accounts payable function in a sole-charge capacity whilst working with a small, close-knit finance team.

Working within a supportive finance team, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end purchase ledger process, ensuring supplier accounts are maintained accurately, invoices are processed efficiently and payments are made on time.

This role would suit someone who enjoys working autonomously, takes pride in maintaining strong financial controls and is comfortable being the go-to person for all Accounts Payable matters.

- Previous experience in a standalone or sole-charge Accounts Payable position.

- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- The ability to manage your own workload and prioritise effectively.
- Confidence communicating with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.
- A proactive approach with the ability to work independently.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of up to 38,000.
- Hybrid working after full training.
- Permanent, full-time opportunity.
- A varied and autonomous role with responsibility for the full Accounts Payable function.
- The opportunity to make the role your own and contribute to improving finance processes.

title: Accounts Receivable Clerk
description:
Orka Financial is recruiting an Accounts Receivable Clerk for a temporary assignment in Reading through to 26 February 2027. This full-time, 35-hour role pays £16-£18 per hour and offers hybrid working, with three days in the office and two from home. Parking is available on site.

The opportunity

Reporting into the Financial Controller, you will take ownership of day-to-day receivables and treasury activity across UK and international operations. You will help keep customer accounts accurate, cash properly allocated and records ready for year-end and external audit.

What you will be doing
- Preparing and posting sales invoices with the correct customer, currency and tax treatment.
- Allocating receipts, investigating unallocated cash and keeping the debtors ledger reconciled.
- Chasing overdue balances and resolving invoice queries with customers and internal teams.
- Completing cashbooks and bank reconciliations across multiple accounts and currencies.
- Producing aged debt and receivables reports, identifying errors and following them through.
- Documenting outstanding items and procedures for a clean handover at the end of the assignment.

What we are looking for

You will have hands-on experience in accounts receivable, sales ledger or credit control, including invoicing and cash allocation. Bank reconciliation and cashbook experience are essential, along with good Excel skills and a careful, organised approach. Exposure to VAT, sales tax, stock or inventory processes and Microsoft Dynamics would be useful.
